title: Player controller
summary: Routes namespaced intent to a compatible entity/session adapter without advancing a world.

blocks.text: Routes namespaced intent to a compatible entity/session adapter without advancing a world.
Capabilities: input.controller@1.0.0; no required or optional services. Constructors receive a spacelab-control-target/1 adapter.
Environment: browser and offline. Platform authority; excluded from authoritative simulation identity. Public API and local source only.

No stored authoritative state. The adapter owns session identity and validates ownership and supported actions. Separate seat/player/entity/viewport IDs. Select, release, ownership change and disposal clear held intent. Every instance is independent.

The factory optionally borrows a local pilot number and ordered input sources. bindInput replaces that binding after releasing old intent; sample uses fixed buffers and routes only target-declared namespaced actions. The last source write wins, missing values release prior intent, and suppression/target changes/disposal release device state. Sources remain owned by their device providers. Existing flight precedence belongs to its explicit adapter.

Unpack, edit source, rebuild and repack. Explicitly enable trusted code in a compatible game; imported code has full application privileges. Package-building success alone does not establish game/runtime portability.
